capabilities: run a local MCP server in the desktop app
search notes by title, vault-relative path, and body content
return the full content of a selected markdown note
append timestamped change notes after per-write confirmation
route clients to the current vault via a vault-specific alias
disambiguation: It does not analyze or edit notes itself; it only exposes the vault to external MCP clients.
extras: Desktop-only: local MCP serving depends on desktop runtime capabilities and is unavailable on mobile. The README states the plugin sends no note content or identifiers to external services, and every append requires per-write confirmation in Obsidian.
problem: MCP clients have no built-in way to search, read, or safely write to an Obsidian vault while the app is running.
summary: Runs a local MCP server in Obsidian so MCP clients can search notes, read a note, and append confirmed change notes.
